content.text: Create exactly one isolated neutral character key pose, centered and fully visible, using the supplied approved south-facing production sprite and character reference as binding design references. Crisp hand-placed pixel art with deliberately low internal pixel resolution, hard pixel edges, no antialiasing, no smooth vector lines, no painterly rendering and no photorealism. Preserve the exact costume, body proportions, palette, silhouette weight, upper-left lighting and fixed 3/4 top-down camera. The approved compact green dungeon minion faces north/away from camera. Preserve the tiny rounded-square head-and-body silhouette, short limbs and simple clothing. Flat uniform pure magenta #FF00FF background with no gradient, floor, cast shadow, glow spill, particles, border, text, letters, numbers, labels, logo, signature or watermark. Do not use magenta in the character. One pose only.
